limitations.v1Fallback: Scored without transcript-structure features. This run's transcript IDs carry version suffixes, so no Ensembl 91 annotation was found and Dolly v2 used its fallback model (equivalent to v1). Its scores are not comparable with the other runs, so it is excluded from cell-line summaries and cross-run statistics. Kept for transparency.
limitations.trainingOverlap: Possible overlap with the training data. On dataset0-labelled sites this run scores far higher than the other Hct116 runs (PR AUC 0.88 vs 0.71), consistent with the training reads coming from this run. Treat its scores on training genes as in-sample.

calibration.source: dataset1 sites whose transcript and gene are absent from dataset0 (HCT116 m6ACE-seq labels), matched to SG-NEx sites by transcript and position
